details:
Out of all the Bugs I've seen during my Experience of the New Update of VRChat v2018.2.3p1:

1) Friends list isn't alphabetized - The entire friends list starts alphabetized till your friends starts coming online or offline and somehow they go straight to the beginning of the list. 

2) Bounced to Public when Joining Friends - When you get invited to go see a friend, you first load into the loading screen and just as you are about to get in, it sends you back into loading and then puts you into a Empty Public World where no one is there not even your friends

3) Friends appear in the world in same instances when they're not - When you invited your friend in a newly established instance world, they accept your invite and somehow when you check and see if they arrive, they show they're in your world but you don't see them anywhere then they get sent to a new world in public instance.

4) Being teleported to a Previously made Instance where the friend is already gone - This occured when the Update was released that when you tried to join on a friend to have fun, you get into the world that was already made your friend was in and once you load in you don't see your friend anywhere when that world you recognized was where you were last time you visit your friend.

5) Going in a Constant Loading loop when gong into one world till it finally sends you to a empty one - This been often happening to me when i tried to join off a friend and it keeps sending me back into the Loading loop and back every time till it stops by sending me to a Empty Public World (Much similar to bouncing to Public bug but with loading loop)

6) Game Crashes sending you to Steam VR Home / Desktop - Just during the time we're having fun in the game and waiting for something to start, all the sudden a short freeze load occurs and next thing you know game crashes sending you to either the Steam VR Home or the Desktop (Depends which game you using Standalone or Steam)

7)Game Freezes but still hear voices like normal - This happens to me ALOT and During the time i was playing with a friend in the world all the sudden the game Screen FREEZES out of the blue which when you move your vr headset it stays in the same position not head tracking but you can still hear the voices normally just fine but I am not sure if its the Game itself or the Headset but it freezes the game screen except the voices you hear.

8) Game lags in constant 11 fps - I had this happen to me ALOT Usually when i load up the game, My net is fine, my graphics and cpu is fine but only thing that bothers me is that I constantly keep getting 11 fps no change whatsoever for every world i go into.
title: Most Bugs Seen occuring from the Update - iBRSMikuru
